WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, count(*) AS n_lines
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 2
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.fiscal_year, ty.fiscal_week, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS growth_pct, ty.n_lines, ly.n_lines
FROM weekly ty
JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctrl_net_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 2
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.calendar_date, d.day_name, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name,
       count(DISTINCT r.store_id) AS stores, sum(r.receipts) AS receipts, round(sum(r.net_sales),0) AS net, round(sum(r.net_sales) FILTER (WHERE r.store_id=900),0) AS web
FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales r ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE (d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 6 AND 8 AND d.fiscal_period=2) OR (d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 7 AND 8 AND d.fiscal_period=2)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 3

SELECT d.fiscal_year, s.store_id = 900 AS is_web, o.status, count(*) AS lines, round(sum(f.net_amount),0) AS net,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL) AS no_dispatch
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26')
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT 'sales_dup_key' AS chk, count(*) AS n FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'sales_dup_id', count(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'return_dup_id', count(*) FROM (SELECT return_line_id FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns_orphan', count(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND r.sales_line_id NOT IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_order_dup', count(*) FROM (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'sales_999_or_test_in_period', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND (s.store_id=999 OR p.category='ZZ Test')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'sales_keys_missing_dim', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND (f.store_key NOT IN (SELECT store_key FROM dim_store) OR f.product_key NOT IN (SELECT product_key FROM dim_product))

WITH x AS (
 SELECT r.store_id, d.fiscal_year, count(DISTINCT r.business_date) FILTER (WHERE d.is_trading_day) AS trading_days_with_sales
 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
 WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND r.store_id<>900 GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT coalesce(a.store_id,b.store_id) AS store_id, a.trading_days_with_sales AS ty_days, b.trading_days_with_sales AS ly_days,
  (SELECT string_agg(c.closure_type||' '||c.closure_start_date||'..'||c.closure_end_date, '; ') FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id=coalesce(a.store_id,b.store_id) AND c.closure_end_date>=DATE '2025-05-26' AND c.closure_start_date<=DATE '2026-06-28') AS closures
FROM (SELECT * FROM x WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27') a FULL JOIN (SELECT * FROM x WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26') b ON a.store_id=b.store_id
WHERE a.trading_days_with_sales IS DISTINCT FROM b.trading_days_with_sales OR a.store_id IS NULL OR b.store_id IS NULL
